justification: The construction is valid: deleting at most two edges leaves the Petersen core connected and can only isolate edgeless leaves, so its line graph is 3-connected; it is also claw-free. Any dominating closed trail must avoid pendant edges and visit every Petersen vertex. Cubicity then forces a Hamiltonian cycle of the Petersen graph, which is impossible. This is the same Petersen-based obstruction as the reference’s triangle inflation.
